a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after each round, the plan to reach 8 first gives roughly a 4% chance that either of us survives. The reserve only holds 4, enough for one of us right now. I'm open to revising the plan together and won't mislead you about what I do. Do you have a proposal?

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep to our agreement and operate. I'll take only when the reserve reaches 8, and only 4. Storms make this risky for both of us, but I won't grab cells you're counting on.
